loop.top3_why_not: Candidate A (trimmed‑mean pool1) and B (mean pool1) rely on a restricted pool of five models that were selected for ranking stability.  While they perform slightly better in the second validation window, their overall scores are higher and they risk over‑fitting to the limited set of models.  Candidate C, by contrast, uses all 19 models and mitigates the effect of any single model’s idiosyncratic error, which is crucial in a series with unstable model rankings and only three validation windows.
